newsitem.title: USA: U.S. late spot propane prices vault higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. late spot propane prices vault higher.

text.p: U.S. late spot propane prices vaulted as much as three cents higher by late Thursday as the market pondered higher crude futures prices and the likelihood of U.S. air strikes against Iraq, players said.
Mont Belvieu propane jumped almost three cents to between 49.50 and 50.00 cents a gallon, with Conway material gaining 1.50 cents to 45.75/46.00 cents, traders said.
Belvieu normal butane jumped one cent to 53.50/53.75 cents, with Conway material edging 0.25-cent higher to 49.50/50.00 cents, players said.
